title: Infinite Portal Rain
description: A surreal painting presented within a weathered gold frame shows a central vertical portal of falling rain and glowing green jellyfish-like orbs. The portal is flanked by repeating concentric rectangular frames that create an infinite mirror effect receding into a misty purple landscape with a reflective body of water and distant trees.
prompt: A surreal painting in an antique cracked gold frame featuring a vertical portal of falling rain and glowing green jellyfish-like organisms floating within a column of blue and purple light. The portal is bordered by repeating concentric rectangular frames creating an infinite tunnel effect over a misty purple landscape with reflective water and distant silhouetted trees.
